Differentiating the two displayed antiderivatives recovers the source pieces, and endpoint substitution with \(\operatorname{Li}_2(-1)=-\pi^2/12\) yields the claimed expression. The included independent numerical replay agrees with direct quadrature to about \(10^{-15}\). Risk: only transcription/algebra error, mitigated by derivative reconstruction and numerical replay.
